column1: # MolmoAct2 LLM-backbone quantization -- FINAL closed-loop grid.
# Scheme: MIXED-PRECISION -- query/key-value/MLP projections quantized to W/A; the
#   attention math (scaled-dot-product attention) kept in bf16. Uniform quantization
#   (attention math included) collapses to 0% even at W8A8.
# Metric: mean LIBERO closed-loop success % over 4 suites (spatial/object/goal/long).
#   PTQ arms: 20 episodes/suite.  QAT arms: 50 episodes/suite.  FP baseline mean = 99.0.
# Flow losses are the held-out flow-matching loss (FP reference for the QAT sweep = 0.2519).
# Reading: PTQ already reaches FP-level success at W>=6 and at W4A8; QAT lowers the flow
#   loss far below FP everywhere but only IMPROVES closed-loop at the 4-bit margin (W4A6
#   W4A4) -- on the higher-bit cells it OVERFITS the flow loss and reduces closed-loop
#   success. 3-bit weights and below fail under both methods. Recommended = better of the two.
